Garage description
This paint is a replica of the area of sky where the alleged alien radio signal SHGb02 + 14a was recorded in March 2003. It was recorded three times and appeared to come from the area between the constellations Pisces and Aries.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
The paint first appeared on April 12, 2014, as a holiday paint for Cosmonautics Day.
Returned on permanent sale on July 21, 2016.
